confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Cape Town price levels rolled forward to July 2026; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant, beer and coffee anchors are moderate confidence; accommodation and hostel anchors are less certain because rates vary by area, season and channel, and July is a low tourism season. Cocktail and wine_glass were set relative to the beer anchor because direct recall is weaker. USD values depend on an assumed rand-to-dollar rate, not a live quote. The FX value comes from a rba.gov.au-restricted search reporting the 14 Oct 2026 figure; the RBA table itself was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Anchors reflect Cape Town's own remembered local price levels, with general South African urban tourism pricing as a loose sanity check and beer-relative ratios for cocktail and wine_glass.
